definitions.explanation: A matter, topic, or subject under consideration. Slightly more formal than こと, and often used when referring to the content or nature of a matter rather than just the fact of its existence.

examples.japanese: {重要|じゅうよう}な{事柄|ことがら}を{確認|かくにん}する。
{以下|いか}の{事柄|ことがら}について{説明|せつめい}します。
examples.english: I will explain the following matters.

examples.japanese: {個人的|こじんてき}な{事柄|ことがら}なので、あまり{詳|くわ}しくは{話|はな}したくない。
examples.english: It's a personal matter, so I'd rather not go into detail.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {重要|じゅうよう}な{事柄|ことがら} (important matters)
- {個人的|こじんてき}な{事柄|ことがら} (personal matters)
- {基本的|きほんてき}な{事柄|ことがら} (basic matters)
- {事柄|ことがら}の{内容|ないよう} (the content of a matter)

{事柄|ことがら} is more formal than こと and tends to appear in written language, presentations, and official communications. It emphasizes the substance or nature of the matter being discussed.
